title: Abagcini Besivuno Esiyimfihlo
intro: Kwilizwe elinohlaza, iqela labantu lenza icebo eliyimfihlo phantsi kobumnyama. Babeneenjongo ezifanayo, kodwa injongo yabo yayingeyiyo eyobulungisa kwaphela. Babengazi ukuba kukho utshintsho olukhulu olubalindele njengoko belele.
clues: Senze isigqibo esiqinileyo, sicinga ukuba icebo lethu alinasiphako.
Sasifuna ukuphuma kwangethuba, ngaphambi kokuba abanye baqalise ukuphazamisana.
Siqalise icebo elichumileyo, siqinisekile ngezinto esizityayo.
Njengoko sifika apho besisiya khona, sayifumana ingenanto kwaye ingenanto, ngoko sacinga ukuba silahlekile.
Emva koko saqonda ukuba yindawo yethu ngenene, saza sakhala siphelelwe lithemba, sityholana ngokulahlekelwa kwethu.
Sasifungile ngaloo ntsasa ukuba singabakhuphi amahlwempu kwisivuno sethu, kodwa isohlwayo sika-Allah safika kuthi xa silele, saguqula igadi yethu yaba yincithakalo.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
